name: Netgear Meural
description: Sign in to Netgear and choose a frame. Tesserae displays one image at a time and creates no Meural galleries. Cloud delivery pauses gallery rotation and keeps the frame's sleep scheduler active. Resume Meural gallery restores your previous playback. Local previews are available as a backup. An optional LAN address enables quiet-hours sleep control.

delivery_method.label: Delivery method
delivery_method.help: Cloud uploads only changed pages and displays one image at a time, without creating galleries. Local previews need Tesserae running and repeat the upload before the preview expires.

host.label: Frame address
host.help: Optional for cloud delivery; used for quiet-hours control. Required for local previews. Filled from your account when available. Reserve its address in your router.

refresh_interval_s.label: Renew preview every
refresh_interval_s.help: Seconds between local uploads of the current page. This must be shorter than the frame's preview duration, which is often 30 seconds. New pages are sent immediately.
